description: For GTA 6 streamers who want clippers to post their moments on TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Reels: let clippers use their Twitch clips free, with credit, or fund a self-serve clipping campaign (the US$100 Launch Test, or from US$50), paying US$1 to US$5 per 1,000 approved views; the 20% fee is charged only on views delivered. Returns the steps, costs and link.
name: get_clipped
title: Get your GTA 6 streams clipped
